name: @algorythmo/brain-cli
description: GBrain CLI dependency for Algorythmo Brain MVP (M3). Managed separately from the frontend bundle.

notes.pin-policy: ADR-0013 — pin by 40-char commit SHA, bump bi-weekly (odd ISO week Mondays) + hotfix lane for CVE/regression. engines/algorythmo/GBRAIN_PINNED_SHA is the single source of truth; this dependency line is a mirror pin record only.
notes.runtime: GBrain is a BUN CLI (package.json engines: bun >=1.3.10; bin entrypoint src/cli.ts), NOT Node/pnpm. It is NOT installed by pnpm in this engine — the production install lives in docker/Dockerfile via `bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain#<GBRAIN_PINNED_SHA>` (reads the SHA file). The gbrain binary is invoked via Open3 subprocess from Brain::Client. For local dev, install per ~/.claude (setup-gbrain / `bun install -g`).
